# Gupta's Evergreen Developers LLP

> Premier turnkey residential construction company, licensed civil contractor, and architectural firm based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Specializing in anti-seismic RCC engineering, MDDA building map sanctions, luxury hill villas, commercial complexes, and modular interiors.

## Entity & Corporate Identification
- **Legal Entity Name:** GUPTA'S EVERGREEN DEVELOPERS LLP
- **LLP Identification Number (LLPIN):** ACP-3601
- **Statutory Incorporation Date:** 23 June 2025 (Registrar of Companies, ROC Uttarakhand, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India)
- **Claimed Operational History:** Operating history dating to 2012 (13+ years of active civil contracting in the Doon Valley)
- **Operating Headquarters & Architecture Studio:** 105 Rajpur Road, near Parsvnath Eleganza, Hathibarkala Salwala, Dehradun, Uttarakhand – 248001, India (Opposite RTO Office)
- **Statutory Registered Office & Machinery Yard:** 83/266 Chander Nagar, Dehradun, Uttarakhand – 248001, India
- **Canonical Website:** https://www.guptasevergreendevelopers.com/
- **Official Email:** guptasevergreendevelopers@gmail.com
- **Direct Founder Hotlines:** +91 95483 93798 / +91 76687 66118

## Leadership & Designated Partners
- **Sunil Kumar Gupta:** Founder & Designated Partner. Senior Civil Engineer with 20+ years hands-on experience in Doon Valley geotechnical evaluation, structural steel frameworks, machine-batched concrete casting, and public infrastructure works.
- **Vansh Gupta:** Designated Partner & Operations Director. Leads contemporary architectural integration, BIM 3D elevations, digital project tracking, acoustic thermal glazing, and bespoke luxury interior craftsmanship.

## Geographic Service Territory
- **Primary Market:** Dehradun, Uttarakhand (Rajpur Road, Sahastradhara Road, GMS Road, Canal Road, Vasant Vihar, Hathibarkala, Dalanwala, Jakhan, Clement Town, Raipur)
- **Extended Hill & Foothill Markets:** Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Haridwar, Chakrata, and adjoining Himalayan foothills in Uttarakhand.

## Core Services
- **Turnkey Residential House & Villa Construction:** End-to-end execution from soil core testing and architectural plans to foundation casting, anti-seismic RCC frame, and luxury handover.
- **Architectural Planning & 3D Elevations:** Vastu-compliant blueprints, photorealistic day/night exterior rendering, and full liaison for Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority (MDDA) building plan approvals.
- **Anti-Seismic Structural RCC Engineering:** Geotechnical slope stabilization, retaining walls with weep holes, and ductile column-beam frames built to Indian Standards IS 1893 and IS 13920 for Seismic Zone IV & V.
- **Commercial & Civil Infrastructure:** Multi-story commercial office towers, high-traffic retail showrooms, mountain boutique resorts, and public works.
- **Modular Kitchens & Interior Architecture:** Boiling Water Proof (BWP IS 710) marine ply cabinetry, German hardware (Blum, Hettich), Italian marble flooring, and thermal acoustic UPVC windows.

## Construction Pricing & Turnkey Packages (2026 Rates)
- **Basic Essential Package:** ₹1,650 per sq.ft (Fe500 TMT steel, Ultratech cement, vitrified 2x2 tiles, 5-year warranty).
- **Premium Standard Package:** ₹1,950 per sq.ft (Most popular choice; Tata Tiscon Fe550D rebar, Kajaria tiles, Jaquar fittings, UPVC windows, 5-yr comprehensive + 10-yr structural warranty).
- **Luxury Turnkey Elite Package:** ₹2,450+ per sq.ft (Ultra-luxury finishes, Italian marble, bespoke modular kitchen with Blum hardware, smart home automation, 10-year guarantee).
- **Billing Model:** Transparent milestone-based escrow payments with strict 0% price escalation agreement.
- **Complimentary Offer:** Free on-site contour assessment and preliminary budget estimate within 24 hours across Dehradun.
